title: Q6
description:
“You are My Son, today I have begotten You.”
Read: Psa 2 (whole psalm), Act 13:32–33
a) In Psa 2 this decree is spoken to Yahweh's anointed king, set on Zion while the nations rage against him. What does that whole scene bring with it when Hebrews uses the line of the Son?
b) Paul applies “today” to the resurrection (Act 13:33). What does Hebrews gain by placing this decree after the Son “sat down” (1:3)? Why can no angel be addressed with it?
